decision: continue a patch-independent firmware optimizer using BOLT infrastructure; first close the supported-ISA extraction/search/import and firmware objective gaps demonstrated on O0 LEMIX SmartSpeaker, pursue a bounded Thumb backend gate separately, and defer FastDyn patch integration to phase two

design_fit.finding: ISA support is necessary but insufficient because firmware observations, placement and cost are outside the pinned tools' native interfaces.
design_fit.formal_limit: The selected STOKE state projection omits device transactions and interrupt schedules, so equality of that projection cannot imply firmware observational equivalence.
design_fit.cost_limit: The selected STOKE latency and measured objectives use Haswell instruction latency.

source_recovery.historical_raw_report: unavailable from the supplied authenticated-library reference and not found locally

source_recovery.selection_note: Three ESCape32 functions were identified exactly. The historical report did not identify its three FreeRTOS list routines, so all five public list.c routines were evaluated.

A labeled 64 KiB linker replica was also built; it is not presented as the unchanged recovered configuration.
